page.layout: Running head at top centre, with page number 37 at the top right. Below it, one large table in two parallel columns of cycle numbers, weekdays, hours and scruples. To the right of the table, a block of text in a narrow column (Neomenia Thisri). Below the table, a centred "D" and, under the left edge, "TABVLA"; at the right, "TABVLÆ" as a catchword-like tail.

main_text.l: Cycli colleCti | fer. | hor. | scrup. | Cycli colleCti | fer. | hor. | scrup.
main_text.p: Neomenia Thisri eundem in diebus, horis & Helakim characterem habere non poteft, nisi post absolutos cyclos Lunares 36288. sunt anni 689472.

page.notes: The table body is reproduced as printed in two parallel columns. The side text is a column beside the table, not a marginal note. The lower-case "TABVLA" under the left edge and the spaced "TABVLÆ" at the right are printed as signatures of the table and are copied as printed. Some digits in the scan are faint; the readings above are the most likely.
